name: Dialogue Tree Engine
description: The brain behind ui.dialogue_box. The box renders lines and reports which button was pressed; this engine owns what those presses mean — node-graph traversal, conditional branches, synchronous checks through progression.attribute_sheet, once-only choice history, and restorable conversation positions. Legacy {label, to, act} choices remain valid. Extended choices may declare stable ids, conditions, once, checks, and consequences; nodes may declare onEnter consequences. Flag writes go to world.world_state_flags, quest actions to progression.quest_log, and journal requests to ui.narrative_journal through explicit events. This engine never applies those world changes itself and never persists itself.

inputs.name: dialogueGraphs
inputs.description: Node tables keyed by conversation id: {start, nodes: {id: {speaker?, text, choices, onEnter?}}}. Legacy choices remain {label, to, act?}. Extended choices add a stable id plus optional conditions, once, consequences, and check {attribute, difficulty?, onPass, onFail}; a checked choice uses those two destinations instead of to. Null destinations end the conversation. Conditions support world flags, quest states and attributes with all/any/not. Consequences are setFlag, quest, or journal actions. Every reachable node retains at least one choice so Dialogue Box can always close it.

inputs.name: defaultSkillCheckDifficulty
inputs.description: Difficulty used when a check omits its own. 10 is a coin-flip for an average build — the right baseline for checks that exist to flavor, not to gate.

inputs.name: allowRevisitResolvedNodes
inputs.description: Whether the player can re-ask resolved branches. False keeps choices weighty; true is the accessibility-friendly codex mode.

inputs.name: initialDialogueStates
inputs.description: Restorable state keyed by conversation id: currentNodeId and resolvedChoiceIds. Once-only choices restored here cannot emit consequences again. World flags, quest state, journal entries, and attribute check history restore through their own owners, not through this input.

outputs.name: currentNodeId
outputs.description: Where the active conversation currently sits.

outputs.name: activeConsequenceFlags
outputs.description: Flags set so far by the active conversation.

outputs.name: availableChoices
outputs.description: Choices whose conditions currently pass, with resolved-check metadata but without exposing hidden future branches.

outputs.name: resolvedChoiceIds
outputs.description: Stable choice ids already resolved in the active conversation; the once-only dedupe boundary.

outputs.name: dialogueStates
outputs.description: Restorable current positions and resolved-choice history keyed by conversation id.
